Writer's p_self on FReD is one positive here, not a pass on any verdict, and recognised rate 0.30 suggests part of it is memory.

cards.title: A moving observer: inertial sensing halves the median path error and the microphone adds nothing as a hard constraint; sensory conflict is detectable; orthogonality costs little until skew is large
cards.finding: A moving observer: inertial sensing halves the median path error and the microphone adds nothing as a hard constraint; sensory conflict is detectable; orthogonality costs little until skew is large
cards.verdict: Locked fusion test killed on means; the inertial gain is the usable part.
cards.limits: Labelled corners, axis-aligned rooms, a rough start given, so loop closure and association are outside this test. These runs measure this estimator and say nothing about why anatomy has its form.

cards.title: A lens and a microphone fitted through one room's modes did not beat either alone: kill condition met in two designs, so there is no gain for the mode basis to claim, and first-order echoes gave the only gain
cards.finding: A lens and a microphone fitted through one room's modes did not beat either alone: kill condition met in two designs, so there is no gain for the mode basis to claim, and first-order echoes gave the only gain
cards.verdict: Preregistered kill met in two designs; simulation.
cards.limits: Simulation, 2D, one fitter, heading given, the echo arm's forward model is simpler than its truth would be. A stronger fitter or a trained one could change every figure. The addendum is a second look at the same rooms, so the echo gain needs a fresh seed.

cards.title: Von Bertalanffy growth across trees and repos: VB is the best of three saturating forms in both media (hold-out wins 0.82 of 66 tree series, 0.68 of 19 repos), but it wins by collapsing toward a straight line, and neither medium shows deceleration beyond linear
cards.finding: Von Bertalanffy beats Gompertz and logistic on hold-out tree and repo growth only by collapsing toward a straight line, and neither medium shows deceleration beyond linear.
